name: Q6 e-tron
description: The Audi Q6 e-tron (2024–present), built on the Premium Platform Electric (PPE) developed jointly with Porsche, is Audi's premium mid-size electric SUV. The PPE platform allows 800V charging, placing the Q6 e-tron above the MEB-based Q4 e-tron in architecture and performance.
